## Join Prestige Automations as Robotics & Automation Engineer!

### Overview
Prestige Automations is seeking a highly skilled Robotics & Automation Engineer to join our cutting-edge engineering team. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in control systems to integrate and innovate within the Oil and Gas sectors. Embrace the opportunity to work across multiple geographical locations and lead projects crafting efficient, reliable systems that push industry standards.

### Key Responsibilities
- Develop, program, and test DCS/PLC systems, refining designs for maximum efficiency.
- Lead projects focusing on pre-commissioning and commissioning, ensuring robust integration with existing infrastructure.
- Design and evaluate control system architectures, including hardware and software components.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure optimal project planning and resource management.
- Prepare detailed project documentation to support project outcomes and client specifications.

### Core Competencies
- Expertise in control system programming (PLC/DCS, HMI) and development.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools such as Power BI and Excel.
- Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage complex projects and teams across multiple disciplines.
- Excellence in customer communication to ensure effective system implementation and support.

### Why Join Us?
At Prestige Automations, we are not just innovating technology; we are redefining the possibilities in automation. Our culture of continuous learning and improvement aims to foster personal growth and professional development in a supportive and inclusive environment.

text:
### Key Account Manager at LuxoTech Solutions

**Location:** Karachi, Pakistan

**Department:** Sales and Marketing

**Reports to:** Director of Sales

**Role Overview:**
Join LuxoTech Solutions as a Key Account Manager where you will be responsible for managing major accounts in the Retail & Hospitality segments across Pakistan. You will drive sales growth by managing existing accounts and developing strategies for new accounts. Your role will involve coordinating with cross-functional teams, analyzing market trends, and leading initiatives to meet revenue targets.

#### Responsibilities:
- Manage a portfolio of 15+ key accounts, comprising both end-users and channel partners.
- Drive expansion into new market segments by identifying and engaging with potential leads.
- Develop and execute account management strategies to achieve 110% target attainment in revenue.
- Utilize data analysis tools such as Power BI to assess market trends and generate insights.
- Coordinate with internal teams including marketing and operations to ensure strategic alignment.
- Lead contract negotiations and manage pricing strategies to optimize profitability.
- Report on account performance and market opportunities to senior management regularly.

#### Essential Skills:
- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in data analysis and forecasting to inform decision-making.
- Experience with tools such as Salesforce, Vistex, and SAP ERP for managing sales functions.
- Excellent communication skills for client interactions and internal collaborations.

#### Qualifications:
- Master's degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field is required.
- 5+ years of experience in sales management or business development, with a focus on key account management.
- Demonstrated success in growing accounts and achieving revenue targets.

#### Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance bonuses.
- Professional development opportunities and access to industry seminars.
- Flexible working hours.

### Key Account Manager at LuxoTech Solutions

**Location:** Karachi, Pakistan

**Department:** Sales and Marketing

**Reports to:** Director of Sales

**Role Overview:**
Join LuxoTech Solutions as a Key Account Manager where you will be responsible for managing major accounts in the Retail & Hospitality segments across Pakistan. You will drive sales growth by managing existing accounts and developing strategies for new accounts. Your role will involve coordinating with cross-functional teams, analyzing market trends, and leading initiatives to meet revenue targets.

#### Responsibilities:
- Manage a portfolio of 15+ key accounts, comprising both end-users and channel partners.
- Drive expansion into new market segments by identifying and engaging with potential leads.
- Develop and execute account management strategies to achieve 110% target attainment in revenue.
- Utilize data analysis tools such as Power BI to assess market trends and generate insights.
- Coordinate with internal teams including marketing and operations to ensure strategic alignment.
- Lead contract negotiations and manage pricing strategies to optimize profitability.
- Report on account performance and market opportunities to senior management regularly.

#### Essential Skills:
- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in data analysis and forecasting to inform decision-making.
- Experience with tools such as Salesforce, Vistex, and SAP ERP for managing sales functions.
- Excellent communication skills for client interactions and internal collaborations.

#### Qualifications:
- Master's degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field is required.
- 5+ years of experience in sales management or business development, with a focus on key account management.
- Demonstrated success in growing accounts and achieving revenue targets.

#### Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance bonuses.
- Professional development opportunities and access to industry seminars.
- Flexible working hours.

Join **Innovate Connections Inc.** as a Lead Generation and Business Intelligence Specialist. You will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by spearheading lead generation initiatives and providing strategic insights through data analytics. We are looking for a highly skilled professional with a strong background in lead generation, data management, and business intelligence.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute lead generation strategies using digital marketing techniques, cold calling, and data scraping tools.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize customer acquisition strategies.
- Utilize CRM systems to manage and analyze client data for lead qualification.
- Create and manage detailed project schedules and work plans, utilizing best practices and standards for project execution.
- Develop financial models and business growth strategies based on data insights.
- Utilize tools such as Power BI, SQL, and Tableau for developing comprehensive data reports and dashboards.

- Strong programming skills in C++, HTML, and CSS.
- Proficiency in digital marketing, email marketing, and social media platforms.
- Experience in managing large data sets and using BI tools (Power BI, Excel, Tableau).
- Excellent communication skills and ability to develop strong client relationships.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- We innovate at the forefront of technology and enable our team members to grow alongside the company.
- We value data-driven decision-making and empower our teams with the right tools to succeed.
- Offering a supportive work environment and opportunities for career advancement.

Submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining Innovate Connections Inc.

### Key Account Manager at LuxoTech Solutions

**Location:** Karachi, Pakistan

**Department:** Sales and Marketing

**Reports to:** Director of Sales

**Role Overview:**
Join LuxoTech Solutions as a Key Account Manager where you will be responsible for managing major accounts in the Retail & Hospitality segments across Pakistan. You will drive sales growth by managing existing accounts and developing strategies for new accounts. Your role will involve coordinating with cross-functional teams, analyzing market trends, and leading initiatives to meet revenue targets.

#### Responsibilities:
- Manage a portfolio of 15+ key accounts, comprising both end-users and channel partners.
- Drive expansion into new market segments by identifying and engaging with potential leads.
- Develop and execute account management strategies to achieve 110% target attainment in revenue.
- Utilize data analysis tools such as Power BI to assess market trends and generate insights.
- Coordinate with internal teams including marketing and operations to ensure strategic alignment.
- Lead contract negotiations and manage pricing strategies to optimize profitability.
- Report on account performance and market opportunities to senior management regularly.

#### Essential Skills:
- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in data analysis and forecasting to inform decision-making.
- Experience with tools such as Salesforce, Vistex, and SAP ERP for managing sales functions.
- Excellent communication skills for client interactions and internal collaborations.

#### Qualifications:
- Master's degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field is required.
- 5+ years of experience in sales management or business development, with a focus on key account management.
- Demonstrated success in growing accounts and achieving revenue targets.

#### Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance bonuses.
- Professional development opportunities and access to industry seminars.
- Flexible working hours.

join **innovate connections inc.** as a lead generation and business intelligence specialist. you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by spearheading lead generation initiatives and providing strategic insights through data analytics. we are looking for a highly skilled professional with a strong background in lead generation, data management, and business intelligence.

### key responsibilities:
- develop and execute lead generation strategies using digital marketing techniques, cold calling, and data scraping tools.
- collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize customer acquisition strategies.
- utilize crm systems to manage and analyze client data for lead qualification.
- create and manage detailed project schedules and work plans, utilizing best practices and standards for project execution.
- develop financial models and business growth strategies based on data insights.
- utilize tools such as power bi, sql, and tableau for developing comprehensive data reports and dashboards.

### desired skills and experience:
- strong programming skills in c++, html, and css.
- proficiency in digital marketing, email marketing, and social media platforms.
- experience in managing large data sets and using bi tools (power bi, excel, tableau).
- excellent communication skills and ability to develop strong client relationships.
- ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

### why innovate connections inc.?
- we innovate at the forefront of technology and enable our team members to grow alongside the company.
- we value data-driven decision-making and empower our teams with the right tools to succeed.
- offering a supportive work environment and opportunities for career advancement.

### how to apply:
submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining innovate connections inc.

#### Requirements:

- Use Microsoft Office Suite effectively for planning, reporting, and presenting sales strategies.

## Job Title: Sales and SEO Management Specialist  

### Location: Lahore, Pakistan  

### Company: Innovate Digital Solutions Inc.  

### Job Summary:  
Join Innovate Digital Solutions Inc. as a Sales and SEO Management Specialist. You will be part of a dynamic team responsible for driving client engagement and ensuring optimal performance in digital marketing strategies. Your role will include managing client relationships, improving SEO strategies, and leading your team to achieve sales targets.  

### Key Responsibilities:  
- Proactively engage with prospective clients to understand their business needs and provide innovative solutions.  
- Design and execute SEO strategies in alignment with client’s marketing objectives.  
- Manage and optimize PPC campaigns to maximize ROI and brand visibility.  
- Develop and maintain strong client relationships through tailored marketing solutions.  
- Lead a team to achieve and surpass sales targets while providing exceptional customer service.  
- Analyze market trends and algorithms to tailor SEO strategies accordingly.  
- Produce reports that track progress and measure success against KPIs.  

### Ideal Candidate Profile:  
You are a skilled sales and marketing professional with strong analytical skills suited to identifying and executing SEO opportunities. You excel at client interactions, possessing the ability to transform potential leads into satisfied clients through strategic and well-executed marketing initiatives. Leadership and team management skills will be pivotal to drive sales and motivate your team.  

### Benefits:  
- Competitive salary package  
- Health and wellness benefits  
- Performance bonuses  
- Opportunities for career advancement  

Join us to redefine digital engagement and lead market strategies with agility and innovation.

### Business Development Manager

**Fictional Company** is seeking a dynamic and strategic Business Development Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you will develop and execute sales strategies, manage key accounts, and lead business development initiatives to drive organizational growth.

#### Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement strategies for business development to achieve corporate goals.
- Oversee the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals.
- Manage and mentor a team of business development executives, enhancing their potential to optimize company success.
- Enhance company presence through active engagement in online platforms like LinkedIn and professional network sites.
- Engage in high-stake negotiations and coordinate with key account stakeholders to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.

#### Requirements:
- Utilize analytical skills to identify new opportunities and market trends.
- Use Microsoft Office Suite effectively for planning, reporting, and presenting sales strategies.

Apex Global Solutions is seeking a dedicated Business Development Manager to bolster our B2B sales efforts and enhance our market presence. This role requires a strategic thinker with the ability to forge and maintain robust client relationships, lead market analysis, and drive revenue growth through innovative sales strategies.

#### Key Responsibilities  
- Develop and implement strategic business development plans to meet organizational goals.
- Identify and qualify new business opportunities and partnerships.
- Lead market research to determine new market segments and customer needs.
- Foster long-term relationships with clients through successful engagement and collaboration.
- Track and report on key business metrics, providing insights and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment and excellence in service delivery.

#### Required Skills  
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Proven experience in B2B sales and marketing, particularly in IT and manufacturing sectors.
- Proficient in market research and data analysis.
- Strong leadership and project management capabilities.

#### Benefits  
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

Join us to spearhead business growth initiatives that deliver significant value and drive our mission forward.

## Junior Electrical Engineer Trainee

**Location**: Lahore, Pakistan  
**Company**: Z-Tech Innovations

### About Us
Z-Tech Innovations is at the forefront of pioneering solutions in electrical engineering and automation. Our core belief is in harnessing technology to simplify lives and enhance mobility. As a Junior Electrical Engineer Trainee, you will be part of an exciting team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

### Job Overview
We are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior Electrical Engineer Trainee to join our dynamic engineering team. This entry-level role is perfect for recent graduates eager to apply their academic knowledge in a practical setting.

### Key Responsibilities
- Participate in project development, including tasks such as sensor integration and automation.  
- Assist in the design and testing of electrical systems using industry-standard tools.  
- Contribute to team discussions and provide insights on the latest trends in electrical engineering technology.  
- Collaborate with senior engineers in developing innovative solutions for industrial applications.  
- Maintain compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental Policies.

### Skills & Qualifications
- **Technical skills**: Proficiency in MATLAB, AutoCAD, Proteus, and familiarity with Arduino IDE.  
- **Soft skills**: Strong communication, teamwork, and report writing skills.  
- **Personal attributes**: Proactive, self-motivated, with a strong willingness to learn and adapt.

### Opportunities
- Experience with real-world projects focused on automation and mobility technologies.  
- Engage in our structured training programs designed to enhance technical skills.  
- Career advancement based on performance and skill growth.

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

### Join Apex Global Solutions as a Business Development Manager  

Apex Global Solutions is seeking a dedicated Business Development Manager to bolster our B2B sales efforts and enhance our market presence. This role requires a strategic thinker with the ability to forge and maintain robust client relationships, lead market analysis, and drive revenue growth through innovative sales strategies.

#### Key Responsibilities  
- Develop and implement strategic business development plans to meet organizational goals.
- Identify and qualify new business opportunities and partnerships.
- Lead market research to determine new market segments and customer needs.
- Foster long-term relationships with clients through successful engagement and collaboration.
- Track and report on key business metrics, providing insights and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment and excellence in service delivery.

#### Required Skills  
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Proven experience in B2B sales and marketing, particularly in IT and manufacturing sectors.
- Proficient in market research and data analysis.
- Strong leadership and project management capabilities.

#### Benefits  
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

Join us to spearhead business growth initiatives that deliver significant value and drive our mission forward.

### Job Title: Senior Wireless Integration Engineer

#### Company: FutureNet Solutions

**Location**: Islamabad, Pakistan

**Job Summary**:  
As a Senior Wireless Integration Engineer, you will join FutureNet Solutions to lead and oversee telecommunication projects across multiple regions. Your responsibilities will include managing cross-functional teams, integrating wireless networks, and coordinating with field teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- Provide remote delivery services for multiple countries, conducting both pre-integration checks and post-integration validations.
- Oversee the integration of 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G NR wireless sites using advanced tools such as Web CME, Cloud CME, and MML commands.
- Coordinate with field teams to supervise installations and resolve on-site technical issues.
- Prepare and manage project schedules and ensure completion in line with client specifications.
- Perform site audits and equipment testing, including Huawei BTS and transmission nodes.
- Act as a key technical support contact for troubleshooting and logical problem resolution.

**Skills & Qualifications**:
- Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or a related field.
- 8+ years of experience in wireless and telecommunications engineering.
- Strong knowledge of GSM, UMTS, LTE, NR technologies, and network troubleshooting.
- Proficiency in Huawei and Nokia RAN-SRAN equipment.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.
- Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects under tight deadlines.

**Salary**: Competitive salary with benefits commensurate with experience.

**How to Apply**: Submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@futurenetsolutions.com by [Deadline].

### Digital Marketing Strategist at InnovateTech Corp

**Location:** Lahore, Pakistan  
**Position:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Marketing 

**About Us:**  
InnovateTech Corp is at the forefront of providing integrated digital solutions tailored to drive business success. Our expertise in leveraging technology to enhance branding and market reach sets us apart in the dynamic world of marketing.

**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking a talented and experienced Digital Marketing Strategist to join our team. You will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and managing digital marketing strategies aligned with our business goals. Your exceptional communication skills and marketing expertise will be pivotal in enhancing our online presence and fostering client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Develop, implement, and manage marketing campaigns that promote the company and its products/services.
- Enhance brand awareness in the digital space.
- Drive website traffic and acquire leads/customers.
- Manage social media strategy and presence.
- Coordinate with the sales team to create marketing campaigns.
- Drive strategies to ensure the achievement of marketing targets.

- Strong analytical and project management skills.
- Deep understanding of how all digital marketing channels function.
- Solid knowledge of online marketing tools and best practices.
- Hands-on experience with SEO/SEM, Google Analytics, and CRM software.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work collaboratively.

**Why InnovateTech Corp?**
- Innovative and growth-driven workplace.
- Opportunities for professional development.
- Competitive salary and benefits.

Join us to reshape the future of digital interaction and marketing!

Z-Tech Innovations is at the forefront of pioneering solutions in electrical engineering and automation. Our core belief is in harnessing technology to simplify lives and enhance mobility. As a Junior Electrical Engineer Trainee, you will be part of an exciting team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

We are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior Electrical Engineer Trainee to join our dynamic engineering team. This entry-level role is perfect for recent graduates eager to apply their academic knowledge in a practical setting.

- Engage in our structured training programs designed to enhance technical skills.  
- Career advancement based on performance and skill growth.

**Location:** Lahore, Pakistan  
**Position:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Marketing 

**About Us:**  
InnovateTech Corp is at the forefront of providing integrated digital solutions tailored to drive business success. Our expertise in leveraging technology to enhance branding and market reach sets us apart in the dynamic world of marketing.

**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking a talented and experienced Digital Marketing Strategist to join our team. You will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and managing digital marketing strategies aligned with our business goals. Your exceptional communication skills and marketing expertise will be pivotal in enhancing our online presence and fostering client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Develop, implement, and manage marketing campaigns that promote the company and its products/services.
- Enhance brand awareness in the digital space.
- Drive website traffic and acquire leads/customers.
- Manage social media strategy and presence.
- Coordinate with the sales team to create marketing campaigns.
- Drive strategies to ensure the achievement of marketing targets.

**Skills & Competencies:**
- Strong analytical and project management skills.
- Deep understanding of how all digital marketing channels function.
- Solid knowledge of online marketing tools and best practices.
- Hands-on experience with SEO/SEM, Google Analytics, and CRM software.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work collaboratively.

**Why InnovateTech Corp?**
- Innovative and growth-driven workplace.
- Opportunities for professional development.
- Competitive salary and benefits.

Join us to reshape the future of digital interaction and marketing!

**Position:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Marketing 

**About Us:**  
InnovateTech Corp is at the forefront of providing integrated digital solutions tailored to drive business success. Our expertise in leveraging technology to enhance branding and market reach sets us apart in the dynamic world of marketing.

**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking a talented and experienced Digital Marketing Strategist to join our team. You will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and managing digital marketing strategies aligned with our business goals. Your exceptional communication skills and marketing expertise will be pivotal in enhancing our online presence and fostering client relationships.

- Develop, implement, and manage marketing campaigns that promote the company and its products/services.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work collaboratively.

**Why InnovateTech Corp?**
- Innovative and growth-driven workplace.
- Opportunities for professional development.
- Competitive salary and benefits.

Join us to reshape the future of digital interaction and marketing!

### Join Apex Global Solutions as a Business Development Manager  

Apex Global Solutions is seeking a dedicated Business Development Manager to bolster our B2B sales efforts and enhance our market presence. This role requires a strategic thinker with the ability to forge and maintain robust client relationships, lead market analysis, and drive revenue growth through innovative sales strategies.

#### Key Responsibilities  
- Develop and implement strategic business development plans to meet organizational goals.

- Lead market research to determine new market segments and customer needs.

#### Required Skills

- Proven experience in B2B sales and marketing, particularly in IT and manufacturing sectors.
- Proficient in market research and data analysis.
- Strong leadership and project management capabilities.

#### Benefits  
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

Join us to spearhead business growth initiatives that deliver significant value and drive our mission forward.

### Job Title: Senior Wireless Integration Engineer

#### Company: FutureNet Solutions

**Location**: Islamabad, Pakistan

**Job Summary**:  
As a Senior Wireless Integration Engineer, you will join FutureNet Solutions to lead and oversee telecommunication projects across multiple regions. Your responsibilities will include managing cross-functional teams, integrating wireless networks, and coordinating with field teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- Provide remote delivery services for multiple countries, conducting both pre-integration checks and post-integration validations.
- Oversee the integration of 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G NR wireless sites using advanced tools such as Web CME, Cloud CME, and MML commands.
- Coordinate with field teams to supervise installations and resolve on-site technical issues.
- Prepare and manage project schedules and ensure completion in line with client specifications.
- Perform site audits and equipment testing, including Huawei BTS and transmission nodes.
- Act as a key technical support contact for troubleshooting and logical problem resolution.

**Skills & Qualifications**:
- Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or a related field.
- 8+ years of experience in wireless and telecommunications engineering.
- Strong knowledge of GSM, UMTS, LTE, NR technologies, and network troubleshooting.
- Proficiency in Huawei and Nokia RAN-SRAN equipment.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.
- Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects under tight deadlines.

**Salary**: Competitive salary with benefits commensurate with experience.

**How to Apply**: Submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@futurenetsolutions.com by [Deadline].

### Job Title: Senior Wireless Integration Engineer

#### Company: FutureNet Solutions

**Location**: Islamabad, Pakistan

**Job Summary**:  
As a Senior Wireless Integration Engineer, you will join FutureNet Solutions to lead and oversee telecommunication projects across multiple regions. Your responsibilities will include managing cross-functional teams, integrating wireless networks, and coordinating with field teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- Provide remote delivery services for multiple countries, conducting both pre-integration checks and post-integration validations.
- Oversee the integration of 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G NR wireless sites using advanced tools such as Web CME, Cloud CME, and MML commands.
- Coordinate with field teams to supervise installations and resolve on-site technical issues.
- Prepare and manage project schedules and ensure completion in line with client specifications.
- Perform site audits and equipment testing, including Huawei BTS and transmission nodes.
- Act as a key technical support contact for troubleshooting and logical problem resolution.

**Skills & Qualifications**:
- Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or a related field.
- 8+ years of experience in wireless and telecommunications engineering.
- Strong knowledge of GSM, UMTS, LTE, NR technologies, and network troubleshooting.
- Proficiency in Huawei and Nokia RAN-SRAN equipment.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.
- Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects under tight deadlines.

**Salary**: Competitive salary with benefits commensurate with experience.

**How to Apply**: Submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@futurenetsolutions.com by [Deadline].

### Job Title: Senior Wireless Integration Engineer

#### Company: FutureNet Solutions

**Location**: Islamabad, Pakistan

**Job Summary**:  
As a Senior Wireless Integration Engineer, you will join FutureNet Solutions to lead and oversee telecommunication projects across multiple regions. Your responsibilities will include managing cross-functional teams, integrating wireless networks, and coordinating with field teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- Provide remote delivery services for multiple countries, conducting both pre-integration checks and post-integration validations.
- Oversee the integration of 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G NR wireless sites using advanced tools such as Web CME, Cloud CME, and MML commands.
- Coordinate with field teams to supervise installations and resolve on-site technical issues.
- Prepare and manage project schedules and ensure completion in line with client specifications.
- Perform site audits and equipment testing, including Huawei BTS and transmission nodes.
- Act as a key technical support contact for troubleshooting and logical problem resolution.

**Skills & Qualifications**:
- Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or a related field.
- 8+ years of experience in wireless and telecommunications engineering.
- Strong knowledge of GSM, UMTS, LTE, NR technologies, and network troubleshooting.
- Proficiency in Huawei and Nokia RAN-SRAN equipment.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.
- Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects under tight deadlines.

**Salary**: Competitive salary with benefits commensurate with experience.

**How to Apply**: Submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@futurenetsolutions.com by [Deadline].

- Competitive salary and benefits.

Join us to reshape the future of digital interaction and marketing!

**Why InnovateTech Corp?**
- Innovative and growth-driven workplace.
- Opportunities for professional development.
- Competitive salary and benefits.

Join us to reshape the future of digital interaction and marketing!

Apex Global Solutions is seeking a dedicated Business Development Manager to bolster our B2B sales efforts and enhance our market presence. This role requires a strategic thinker with the ability to forge and maintain robust client relationships, lead market analysis, and drive revenue growth through innovative sales strategies.

- Proficient in market research and data analysis.
- Strong leadership and project management capabilities.

#### Benefits  
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

Join us to spearhead business growth initiatives that deliver significant value and drive our mission forward.

Apex Global Solutions is seeking a dedicated Business Development Manager to bolster our B2B sales efforts and enhance our market presence. This role requires a strategic thinker with the ability to forge and maintain robust client relationships, lead market analysis, and drive revenue growth through innovative sales strategies.

#### Key Responsibilities  
- Develop and implement strategic business development plans to meet organizational goals.
- Identify and qualify new business opportunities and partnerships.
- Lead market research to determine new market segments and customer needs.
- Foster long-term relationships with clients through successful engagement and collaboration.
- Track and report on key business metrics, providing insights and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment and excellence in service delivery.

#### Required Skills  
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Proven experience in B2B sales and marketing, particularly in IT and manufacturing sectors.
- Proficient in market research and data analysis.
- Strong leadership and project management capabilities.

#### Benefits  
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

Join us to spearhead business growth initiatives that deliver significant value and drive our mission forward.

Below are the Expectations and Key Performance Indicators for Inside Sales and/or  as 
Assigned by your Reporting Manager  
 
Every individual in inside sales team is required to contribute at least 3 leads (scheduled meetings along with spec 
sheets /company details shared with relevant sales teams) per week. That would be 12 scheduled meetings per 
month out of which at least 4 should be qualified.  
By definition qualified would mean a lead (scheduled meeting)  should fulfil the ANUM criteria.  
A- Authority, the person should be relevant to the product/service we’re selling. He/she should either be the 
influencer or decision maker  
N- there should be need for what we’re trying to sell  
U- urgency, should be a defined timeline for the project  
M- a budget allocated or at least defined for the project.   
 
All individuals should be well - versed on  their respective campaigns ( We’ll schedule their training sessions with the 
relevant presales). They need to make sure to have the right level of knowledge of the product/service to try to 
convince a prospect for a meeting and/or to prequalify a meeting.   
Every lead source needs to be present in their scheduled meeting as a moderator and share the minutes of 
meetings after every meeting.   
 
Once a meeting is scheduled following measures need to be taken:  
 Timely handover the lead to the concerned sales/pre sa les team including the spec sheet /company details 
and not just the invite. There should be at least a 48 -hour difference before handing over to sales. So if 
you get connected with some body this week, you try to schedule a slot with them for the following o ne 
and buy some time to get the prequalification details - Exceptions would be entertained either way.   
 No lead would be forwarded to sales without any prequalification details from the prospect (following the 
process that I've shared and/or take internal c alls and then handover).  We'll still consider the exceptions 
in some cases which shouldn't be more then 15 -20 percent.   
 Every individual is supposed to maintain a repository of the sales pipeline in terms of important follow ups 
before or after the meeting  is scheduled, hot and qualified leads. Hound the individuals and get a 
response be it with prospects or sales teams. In case a potential prospect has gone dormant, strategize 
with me and we'll get it to the table.   
Below are the relevant sales teams for r espective campaigns.   
AI/ML – Dr. Ali and Rashid Z afar 
Flex - Kamran Khalid and Asad J aved   
Custom app D ev/PS  - Rashid Z afar 
AWS - Furrukh S ohail and Raj   
Please be certain that I am looped in, in all your communications with them, lead  assignments/ spec 
sheets /details.  
 
Timings are  from 4:30 pm to 1 am  following and overlapping EST and UK time respectively.  
The star performers in my team i.e. the ones achieving and/or overachieving their weekly and monthly targets in 
my team would enjoy a relaxed environment and  flexible timings.  
They would have liberty to take long breaks or even leave early, opportunity to work from home - having all this 
discussed and approved by me.   
On the contrary non performers would not be able to enjoy any perks.  
Above all, the culture a nd environment of the team and company is of utmost priority any individual found 
instilling  negativity to the environment  and/or demotivation effecting team productivity would then and there be 
laid off.

**Department:** Marketing

InnovateTech Corp is at the forefront of providing integrated digital solutions tailored to drive business success. Our expertise in leveraging technology to enhance branding and market reach sets us apart in the dynamic world of marketing.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Digital Marketing Strategist to join our team. - Innovative and growth-driven workplace.
- Opportunities for professional development.
- Competitive salary and benefits.

- Strong leadership and project management capabilities.

#### Benefits  
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
- Health and wellness benefits package.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.
